NFL DFS Week 3 Picks: Top DraftKings Projections, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, September 27 · 13 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 24, 12:30 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 3 DraftKings main slate: 29.9 DraftKings points at $8,800. He also holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Kenneth Walker III second at 32% for $7,400.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Kenneth Walker III (22.4, $7,400), Jonathan Taylor (21.8, $7,600), Amon-Ra St. Brown (21.3, $7,900) and James Cook III (21.2, $6,900). Jahmyr Gibbs returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.40 projected points per $1,000. Amon-Ra St. Brown leads the wide receivers at 21.3 for $7,900, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.1 for $8,000, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 17.8 for $6,700.

The 13-game slate runs from a 52.5-point total in BAL at DAL down to 39.5 in SEA at WAS. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 24, 12:30 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 3 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs LAC ($8,000)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.1 DraftKings points at $8,000. That is 1.4 points clear of Patrick Mahomes. The model includes 6.4 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.64 projected points per $1,000, 20th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.2 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 39.3, and he holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Patrick Mahomes, KC at MIA ($6,200)

Patrick Mahomes projects 2nd at the position with 19.7 DraftKings points at $6,200. The model includes 4.1 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.18 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 19.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.5 and a ceiling of 36.5, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 11.5-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Deshaun Watson, CLE vs CAR ($4,700)

Deshaun Watson projects for 18.2 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.87 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 6.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 33.4, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 2.5-point underdog at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 20 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 29.6 points with a simulated floor of 11.3 and a ceiling of 57.9, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 27.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 22.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 43.0, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Across 10,000 simulations Taylor averaged 21.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 42.4, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 2.5-point underdog at home against Houston, with an implied team total of 20.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.
